Meaning: Foreign Key -- references another table's primary key
Generated Column -- value automatically derived from an expression
Used as a boolean flag: 0 = false/inactive, 1 = true/active
Tables with is_archived, is_active, archived_by, archived_at, archive_reason use soft deletion
schedules and exam_schedules use version, locked_by, locked_at to prevent concurrent edit conflicts
archives table stores copied text values at archival time, independent of future changes to source tables
updated_at columns are set to current_timestamp() automatically on every UPDATE statement
When the parent row is deleted, all referencing child rows are automatically deleted
When the parent row is deleted, the FK column in the child row is set to NULL (child row kept)
The parent row CANNOT be deleted while any child rows reference it (results in an error)
